scope: Single frozen public passage, not full repository

claims.description: The master plan's Implementation Goals section sets out how the plan will be used and implemented to lead to catalytic redevelopment of the Dayton Mall Area.
claims.name: Implementation Goals (Section 7.02)

claims.description: Chapter 7.02 identifies specific actions and strategies to achieve ten major goals (“triumphs”) that reflect the Dayton Mall Area Master Plan’s goals and serve as catalysts for further transformation in the Mall Area.
claims.name: identify specific actions and strategies to achieve ten major “triumphs”

claims.description: Ten major “triumphs” reflecting the master plan’s goals, with a “10 Triumphs in 10 Years” label; they are based on prior analysis, outreach, research and planning and will catalyze further transformation in the Mall Area.
claims.name: 10 Triumphs in 10 Years

claims.description: Stakeholder municipalities, private-sector partners and advocacy organizations will each have a role to make the plan a “living” plan that is used and implemented and leads to catalytic redevelopment of the area.
claims.name: make the Dayton Mall Area Master Plan a “living” plan that is used, implemented and leads to catalytic redevelopment of the area

claims.description: Stakeholder municipalities, private-sector partners and advocacy organizations will each have a role, alongside strategic integration of physical, economic and social investments to build the critical mass of support needed to achieve the community’s goals for the Mall Area.
claims.name: strategically integrating physical, economic and social investments will create a critical mass of support needed to achieve the community’s goals for the Mall Area

claims.description: The transformation applies to the mall area, to be made more accessible, welcoming and green as a place to live, work and play.
claims.name: more accessible, welcoming and green place to live, work and play

claims.description: Local municipalities, businesses, developers, community organizations and other stakeholders are named as each having a role in the mall area’s transformation.
claims.entity: local municipalities, businesses, developers, community organizations and other stakeholders
claims.name: role to play in the transformation of the mall area

claims.description: A matrix following the Implementation Goals section that identifies actions to achieve each goal, the key partners that need to collaborate, the priority of each action and a proposed timeline of completion.
claims.name: Implementation Matrix

claims.description: Each action in the Implementation Matrix has a priority of each action recorded.
claims.name: priority of each action

claims.description: The Implementation Matrix gives a proposed (not finalized) timeline for completing each action.
claims.name: proposed timeline of completion

claims.description: Catalytic Development (“Unlocking Potential”) comprises three major triumphs for the Dayton Mall Area that involve new development: the design and construction of new buildings, streets and open spaces beginning to transform the entire district.
claims.name: Unlocking Potential: Catalytic Development

claims.description: Three major Dayton Mall Area triumphs involve the design and construction of new buildings, streets and open spaces that begin to transform the entire district.
claims.name: three major triumphs for the Dayton Mall Area involve new development

claims.description: Within the Dayton Mall Area Master Plan, catalytic redevelopment is linked to the plan being implemented (“living” plan) and to the master plan's ten triumphs.
claims.name: transformation of the mall area

uncertainties: The passage breaks off mid-sentence (“Local municipalities, bus”), so the roles of some stakeholders, such as local municipalities, businesses, developers and community organizations, may continue in the missing text.
The text does not name the individual ten triumphs beyond the three new-development triumphs under “Unlocking Potential: Catalytic Development.”
Whether “stakeholder municipalities” is a defined term for the municipalities with a role is unclear; a later passage lists “Local municipalities” separately as having a role in the transformation.
